reviewerName: Codex AI-assisted editor synthesizing independent Luna and Terra reviews
note: Two independent AI-assisted reviewers evaluated the exact pack hash, matching source row, and schema. The recorded evidence synthesizes their findings and a source-level consistency check. Review is not human or learner validation. The rights/authorship statement is locally declared and not independently verified. Requested Luna route was not exposed (runtime-visible model label GPT-6); Terra route was gpt-5.6-terra (runtime label Codex GPT-6).

criteria.prompt: Original/permitted source, author, distribution rights and no learner PII checked.
criteria.evidence: Both independent reviewers checked the local provenance declaration for AI-assisted original educational text, authorized distribution, no copied exam/external source or learner PII; no PII is visible. This is a local declaration check, not independent rights verification.

criteria.prompt: Phrase occurs in cited source and the contextual sense is supported.
criteria.evidence: Both confirm “fair comparison” appears verbatim in cited s3 and the reading grounds it in observing both routes at the same time on several clear days.

criteria.prompt: English gloss is the actual contextual meaning, not a selection rationale.
criteria.evidence: Both confirm the English gloss accurately describes comparison under equal conditions, matching the survey procedure.

criteria.prompt: Vietnamese gloss is accurate, natural and includes diacritics.
criteria.evidence: Both confirm “sự so sánh công bằng” is natural and accurate Vietnamese.
